name: RAPP DOGG — pull protocol canon instead of guessing
summary: Hotload one file and a brainstem knows rapp/1 exactly instead of guessing. Pulls the current protocol canon — frame rules, identity minting law, kind families, egg determinism, the exchange contract, and the vocabulary with each term's status — from a public, static, unauthenticated DOGG anchor, and injects it into the system prompt every turn. Read-only: installs nothing, executes nothing it fetches.
tagline: Meet an out-of-date peer, hand it the answer AND the anchor — both get smarter.
author: RapterBox
